headline: Regional broadcasters seek to monetize their towers with telecom services
summary: Radio Independiente de México, which groups 286 AM and FM stations, is exploring new business models to monetize its infrastructure. The move aims to diversify income as advertising investment falls.
why: Broadcast towers can generate rental income when shared with telecom operators, a revenue model that matters for media groups facing advertising declines. Radio Independiente de México is an industry association for regional broadcasters.
original_headline: Radiodifusoras regionales buscan monetizar sus torres con servicios telecom
